-- | ublic
--   
--   Core types (Trace, MetaTrace, LogFormatting) and combinators
--   (traceWith, contramapM, foldTraceM, routingTrace) that form the stable
--   API surface of the Hermod tracing system. Packages that implement or
--   consume tracers can depend on this package without pulling in the full
--   hermod-tracing-core implementation. . This package exposes two
--   sublibraries. User-space packages should depend only on
--   <tt>hermod-tracing-api</tt> (the <tt>public</tt> sublibrary). The
--   <tt>internal</tt> sublibrary is not a stable API — it may change
--   between any two releases without a major version bump. Its
--   <tt>visibility: public</tt> declaration exists solely to allow
--   <tt>hermod-tracing-core</tt> (a separate Cabal package) to depend on
--   it; this is an accepted Haskell ecosystem pattern (cf.
--   <tt>text:text-internal</tt>).
@package hermod-tracing-api:public
@version 1.0.0


-- | Stable public API for the Hermod tracing system.
--   
--   This is the single-import front door for <tt>hermod-tracing-api</tt>.
--   It re-exports everything a package needs to:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><b>Define trace types</b>: write <a>LogFormatting</a>
--   (human/machine rendering, metrics) and <a>MetaTrace</a> (namespace,
--   severity, documentation) instances for your domain message types.</li>
--   <li><b>Dispatch messages</b>: call <a>traceWith</a> to emit,
--   <a>contramapM</a> to adapt types, <a>foldTraceM</a> to accumulate
--   state, <a>routingTrace</a> to fan out.</li>
--   <li><b>Filter</b>: <a>filterTrace</a>, <a>filterTraceMaybe</a>.</li>
--   </ul>
--   
--   <h3>For tracer authors</h3>
--   
--   <pre>
--   Trace                  -- the central carrier opaque type
--   LogFormatting(..)      -- typeclass: forMachine, forHuman, asMetrics
--   MetaTrace(..)          -- typeclass: namespaceFor, severityFor, documentFor, …
--   Metric(..)             -- metric payload (IntM, DoubleM, CounterM, LabelSetM)
--   Namespace(..)          -- hierarchical trace identifier
--   SeverityS(..)          -- message severity (Debug … Emergency)
--   SeverityF(..)          -- severity filter (Nothing = Silence)
--   Privacy(..)            -- Public | Confidential
--   DetailLevel(..)        -- DMinimal … DMaximum
--   Folding(..)            -- wrapper for fold-based stateful tracers
--   </pre>
--   
--   <h3>Configuration and control (consumed by
--   <tt>hermod-tracing-core</tt>)</h3>
--   
--   <a>TraceConfig</a>, <a>ConfigOption</a>, <a>BackendConfig</a>,
--   <a>ConfigReflection</a>, <a>DocCollector</a>, <tt>ForwarderAddr</tt>,
--   <a>ForwarderMode</a>, <a>TraceOptionForwarder</a>,
--   <a>PrometheusSimpleRun</a>. These appear in type signatures throughout
--   the system; tracer authors typically do not construct them directly.
module Hermod.Tracing.API
data () => Trace (m :: Type -> Type) a
newtype () => Folding a b
Folding :: b -> Folding a b
data () => CounterAction
CounterIncrement :: CounterAction
CounterAdd :: Word64 -> CounterAction
data () => DetailLevel
DMinimal :: DetailLevel
DNormal :: DetailLevel
DDetailed :: DetailLevel
DMaximum :: DetailLevel
data () => Metric
IntM :: Text -> Integer -> Metric
DoubleM :: Text -> Double -> Metric
CounterM :: Text -> CounterAction -> Metric
LabelSetM :: Text -> [(Text, Text)] -> Metric
data () => Namespace a
Namespace :: [Text] -> [Text] -> Namespace a
[nsPrefix] :: Namespace a -> [Text]
[nsInner] :: Namespace a -> [Text]
data () => Privacy
Confidential :: Privacy
Public :: Privacy
newtype () => SeverityF
SeverityF :: Maybe SeverityS -> SeverityF
data () => SeverityS
Debug :: SeverityS
Info :: SeverityS
Notice :: SeverityS
Warning :: SeverityS
Error :: SeverityS
Critical :: SeverityS
Alert :: SeverityS
Emergency :: SeverityS
data () => BackendConfig
Forwarder :: BackendConfig
Stdout :: FormatLogging -> BackendConfig
EKGBackend :: BackendConfig
DatapointBackend :: BackendConfig
PrometheusSimple :: Bool -> Maybe HostName -> PortNumber -> BackendConfig
data () => ConfigOption
ConfSeverity :: SeverityF -> ConfigOption
[severity] :: ConfigOption -> SeverityF
ConfDetail :: DetailLevel -> ConfigOption
[detail] :: ConfigOption -> DetailLevel
ConfBackend :: [BackendConfig] -> ConfigOption
[backends] :: ConfigOption -> [BackendConfig]
ConfLimiter :: Double -> ConfigOption
[maxFrequency] :: ConfigOption -> Double
data () => FormatLogging
HumanFormatColoured :: FormatLogging
HumanFormatUncoloured :: FormatLogging
MachineFormat :: FormatLogging
data () => ForwarderMode
Initiator :: ForwarderMode
Responder :: ForwarderMode
data () => PrometheusSimpleRun
PrometheusSimpleRun :: Maybe Word -> Maybe Word -> Maybe Word -> Maybe Double -> PrometheusSimpleRun
[connTimeout] :: PrometheusSimpleRun -> Maybe Word
[connCountGlobal] :: PrometheusSimpleRun -> Maybe Word
[connCountPerHost] :: PrometheusSimpleRun -> Maybe Word
[connPerSecond] :: PrometheusSimpleRun -> Maybe Double
data () => TraceConfig
TraceConfig :: Map [Text] [ConfigOption] -> Maybe TraceOptionForwarder -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Map Text Word64 -> Maybe PrometheusSimpleRun -> TraceConfig
[tcOptions] :: TraceConfig -> Map [Text] [ConfigOption]
[tcForwarder] :: TraceConfig -> Maybe TraceOptionForwarder
[tcApplicationName] :: TraceConfig -> Maybe Text
[tcMetricsPrefix] :: TraceConfig -> Maybe Text
[tcPeriodicTracers] :: TraceConfig -> Map Text Word64
[tcPrometheusSimpleRun] :: TraceConfig -> Maybe PrometheusSimpleRun
data () => TraceOptionForwarder
TraceOptionForwarder :: Word -> Verbosity -> Word -> TraceOptionForwarder
[tofQueueSize] :: TraceOptionForwarder -> Word
[tofVerbosity] :: TraceOptionForwarder -> Verbosity
[tofMaxReconnectDelay] :: TraceOptionForwarder -> Word
data () => Verbosity
Maximum :: Verbosity
Minimum :: Verbosity
data () => ConfigReflection
ConfigReflection :: IORef (Set [Text]) -> IORef (Set [Text]) -> IORef (Set [Text]) -> ConfigReflection
[crSilent] :: ConfigReflection -> IORef (Set [Text])
[crNoMetrics] :: ConfigReflection -> IORef (Set [Text])
[crAllTracers] :: ConfigReflection -> IORef (Set [Text])
newtype () => DocCollector
DocCollector :: IORef (Map Int LogDoc) -> DocCollector
class () => LogFormatting a
forMachine :: LogFormatting a => DetailLevel -> a -> Object
forHuman :: LogFormatting a => a -> Text
asMetrics :: LogFormatting a => a -> [Metric]
class () => MetaTrace a
namespaceFor :: MetaTrace a => a -> Namespace a
severityFor :: MetaTrace a => Namespace a -> Maybe a -> Maybe SeverityS
privacyFor :: MetaTrace a => Namespace a -> Maybe a -> Maybe Privacy
detailsFor :: MetaTrace a => Namespace a -> Maybe a -> Maybe DetailLevel
documentFor :: MetaTrace a => Namespace a -> Maybe Text
metricsDocFor :: MetaTrace a => Namespace a -> [(Text, Text)]
allNamespaces :: MetaTrace a => [Namespace a]
traceWith :: Monad m => Trace m a -> a -> m ()
unfold :: Folding a b -> b
routingTrace :: Monad m => (a -> m (Trace m a)) -> Trace m a -> Trace m a
filterTraceMaybe :: forall (m :: Type -> Type) a. Monad m => Trace m a -> Trace m (Maybe a)
emptyLoggingContext :: LoggingContext
getMetricName :: Metric -> Text
nsCast :: Namespace a -> Namespace b
nsGetComplete :: Namespace a -> [Text]
nsGetTuple :: Namespace a -> ([Text], [Text])
nsPrependInner :: Text -> Namespace a -> Namespace b
nsRawToText :: ([Text], [Text]) -> Text
nsReplaceInner :: [Text] -> Namespace a -> Namespace a
nsReplacePrefix :: [Text] -> Namespace a -> Namespace a
nsToText :: Namespace a -> Text
defaultForwarder :: TraceOptionForwarder
emptyTraceConfig :: TraceConfig
parsePrometheusString :: Text -> Either String BackendConfig
prometheusSimpleNoOverrides :: PrometheusSimpleRun
emptyConfigReflection :: IO ConfigReflection
emptyLogDoc :: Text -> [(Text, Text)] -> LogDoc

-- | Contramap a monadic function over a trace.
contramapM :: Monad m => Trace m b -> (a -> m b) -> Trace m a

-- | Like <a>contramapM</a> but can also filter out messages by returning
--   <a>Nothing</a>.
contramapMCond :: Monad m => Trace m b -> (a -> m (Maybe b)) -> Trace m a

-- | Fold a monadic accumulator function over a trace. Uses an
--   <tt>MVar</tt> to hold the state.
foldTraceM :: forall a acc m. MonadUnliftIO m => (acc -> a -> m acc) -> acc -> Trace m (Folding a acc) -> m (Trace m a)

-- | Like <a>foldTraceM</a> but additionally filter the trace by a
--   predicate.
foldCondTraceM :: forall a acc m. MonadUnliftIO m => (acc -> a -> m acc) -> acc -> (a -> Bool) -> Trace m (Folding a acc) -> m (Trace m a)
filterTrace :: Monad m => (a -> Bool) -> Trace m a -> Trace m a
